newsitem.title: USA: Sensormatic sees revs up in first half of 98.
newsitem.headline: Sensormatic sees revs up in first half of 98.

text.p: Sensormatic Electronics Corp said Friday it expects revenues for the fourth quarter to be comparable to the third quarter of fiscal 1997, but it expects increased revenues in the first half of fiscal 1998.
The company said it expects these increased revenues because of the scheduled release of new products.

The company said its gross margins were 47.3 percent for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 compared to 45 percent, excluding a special charge, in the year ago quarter. The company said the gross margin trend during the last three quarters has improved.
